title: Dominant Young Diagrams in Matrix Models and Partial Deconfinement
summary: We discuss dominant representations (or Young diagrams), in thermal matrix models with gauge symmetry from the perspective of partial deconfinement. We propose a prescription for defining the dominant representations for thermal matrix models with interaction terms. As an explicit example, we consider the large-$N$ Gaussian matrix model. We obtain the Vershik--Kerov--Logan--Shepp (VKLS) shape of the dominant Young diagrams through a new analytic saddle-point analysis based on a mapping of the representation theory of U($\infty$) to free fermions in two spacetime dimensions.
